summary: Replaced the stale embedded-Mongo local supervisor with a cross-platform native Node runtime that requires an external non-production MONGODB_URI, performs live API/Web/Mongo readiness checks, owns and cleans only its child processes, rotates logs, and applies deterministic idempotent v1/v2 synthetic showcase seeds without public private-file URLs. Updated local documentation and environment guidance to remove active Docker/download assumptions.

verification.notes: Clean install completed with 397 packages, 403 audited, and zero reported vulnerabilities.
Expected safe refusal because an existing user-owned .env.local was present; the command did not overwrite it.

verification.command: npm.cmd run local:doctor with a process-only external MongoDB URI override
verification.notes: Verified Node 24.19.0, npm 11.x, reachable standalone non-production MongoDB, writable runtime paths, dependency state, and free application ports without printing the URI or reading real .env contents.

verification.command: npm.cmd run local:up && npm.cmd run local:status && npm.cmd run local:seed && npm.cmd run local:smoke
verification.notes: Native API, Web SSR, SMTP catcher, and proxy reached ready state; status performed live checks; seed reapplied with applied=0; smoke passed twice with populated counts, API readiness, invalid API 404, private-file denial, and security headers.

verification.command: npm.cmd run local:down; npm.cmd run local:status; npm.cmd run local:up; npm.cmd run local:status; npm.cmd run local:smoke
verification.notes: Shutdown left the repository-owned runtime stopped, restart reached ready again, and post-restart smoke passed.

15 focused runtime/artifact tests and 6 seed tests passed, including readiness failure behavior, native process ownership, standalone Mongo guard, idempotence, workflow coverage, and private payment-proof metadata safety.
Contracts, API, and Web TypeScript checks passed.
Workspace policy and ESLint completed with zero warnings/errors.
Contracts, API, client, SSR, and bundle-budget checks passed.
131 screens, 198 tasks, source checksums, English-only Agent Pack policy, and the single in-progress-task rule were valid before closure.

knownLimitations: The existing user-owned .env.local was not opened, printed, or rewritten; it must be pointed at the intended installed service or isolated Atlas URI before an ordinary local start.
Automatic administrator bootstrap remains disabled for standalone MongoDB because transactions require a replica set or Atlas; this is intentional fail-closed behavior.
A live database-loss drill was not performed by stopping a privileged MongoDB service; readiness failure behavior is covered by focused API tests and the supervisor tears down on dependency loss.
Production SMTP, native Ubuntu/Nginx/systemd execution, backup/restore, external scanner/storage, and remote deployment remain outside this repository-only task.
